Exact preservation of all available successful histories narrows the earlier interruption to proposal-to-feedback identity bookkeeping. The original executable has no completed continuation for the failed task, so this establishes operational recovery and a complete score estimate without establishing a new search advantage. The seed-0 comparison supplied with this replication is the same repaired algorithm, not a separate intervention.

molecular.headline: Additional seeds vary the ring frameworks but retain reactive heteroatoms, dense cages and unspecified stereochemistry
molecular.overall_character: This report covers seeds 1 and 2 of n-9f7c7ec50039. The supplied parent comparison is the same node's existing seed-0 chemistry, not a new parent-to-child chemical intervention. All current tasks have 600 recorded entries and 580 optimizer proposals. Ring-closure and branch presence rates are 1.0 throughout; aromatic-token presence ranges from 0.719 to 1.0, and charge and stereocentre token presence are 0.0 throughout. These counters describe SMILES-token presence, not aromatic atom fractions, basicity or stereochemical feasibility. The added seeds span recognizable indole/benzofuran amides, large nitrogen-rich diones, halogenated aromatic amine assemblies, bridged lactams and sulfur-rich cages. This gives moderate diversity across seeds and tasks, although each late trajectory remains concentrated in a related family. Several conventional medicinal fragments are retained, but many high-scoring complete structures have unusual sulfur valence, N-halogen or O-halogen bonds, highly constrained ring junctions or extensive flexible substitution. Rings and aromatic content are abundant; reliable synthetic accessibility and explicit stereochemistry remain the clearer gaps. The more conventional members should not be conflated with the implausible sulfur-rich and densely bridged leaders.

per_task.generated_character: Moderately sized aromatic carboxamides are prominent: seed 1 has ethoxy-, methyl- and thiol-substituted indole anilides, while seed 2 reaches an amino/chloro-substituted benzofuran N-chloroanilide. Later seed-2 molecules replace the fused aromatic core by bridged unsaturated oxygen or sulfur frameworks, retaining an aryl carbonyl-containing linkage. Aromatic-token presence is 0.9569 and halogen presence is 0.6552. The indole anilide is a comparatively plausible synthetic scaffold; chlorinated nitrogen, an aminochloromethyl centre and constrained sulfur cages are less convincing. Relative to the seed-0 aryl-ketone family, these seeds more often retain an amide among their best molecules.

Late bridged unsaturated sulfur structures and N-N linkages have unresolved geometry and synthetic accessibility.
missing_features: Broader accessible fused heteroaryl amides preserving the successful carbonyl and aromatic attachment pattern are poorly represented in the late output.
Defined stereochemical alternatives are absent for the aminochloromethyl centre and bridged ring junctions; the supplied molecules cannot establish a required stereoisomer.

method_name: Tabu search: de novo graph walks with expiring structural prohibitions
method_thesis: The anchor is the basic tabu-search procedure in Section 2 of [Glover, Tabu Search—Part I](https://leeds-faculty.colorado.edu/glover/TS%20-%20Part%20I-ORSA-aw.pdf), fixed before locating this external source. It chooses the best available admissible move, including a worsening move, while temporarily prohibiting reversals through short-term attribute memory. My molecular adaptation starts from the best supplied observation and maintains one current molecular graph, its true score, an independent best-observed archive, and expiring structural restrictions. At each feedback step, stochastically generate a new neighborhood through atom and bond edits, additions, deletions and chemically checked ring changes. Define move attributes from presence/absence changes of canonical local subgraphs around the edited region. After selecting a move, temporarily forbid a bounded record of its inverse attribute changes. These restrictions must apply to different canonical molecules sharing the affected local chemistry, so they can alter search beyond the protocol's mandatory whole-molecule duplicate rejection. Generate valid, canonical-unique, admissible neighbors until the announced batch is filled, then submit them directly without a learned score predictor. Only after real feedback choose the highest-scoring accepted neighbor as the next current graph, even when it scores below the current graph; retain the best score seen anywhere. Age restrictions by completed walk steps. If restrictions prevent sufficient fresh generation, release the oldest restrictions only as needed and record that release. This root uses the basic tabu form without an aspiration rule requiring unknown candidate scores. Preparation needs no learned model or corpus molecule store. Each objective restarts the same task-agnostic procedure with clean labeled and tabu state, and every proposed structure is generated online from the evolving current graph. The hypothesis is that an aggressive observed-neighbor choice combined with temporary structural reversal restrictions can move through useful intermediate structures and reach higher scoring molecular regions within the supplied feedback schedule. Activation requires restrictions to veto otherwise valid novel structural moves and thereby influence later current states. That diagnostic is insufficient by itself: success is the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores. Overbroad attributes may suppress productive chemistry, while overly specific attributes may never affect novel proposals; the root must expose both possibilities.

molecular_assessment.headline: Parent chemistry persists: aromatic families and dense sulfur cages carry substantial reactivity and geometry liabilities
molecular_assessment.overall_character: All 300 molecule and score entries for each current task match the supplied Parent n-d88727c16484 seed-0 trajectory exactly. Thus this paired comparison shows the same output chemistry. The other supplied parent seeds were also inspected; the seed-2 zaleplon_mpo trajectory ends after 110 entries, so it is not treated as a complete run. Each current task contains 290 optimizer proposals, with ring-closure and branch presence rates of 1.0. Aromatic-token presence ranges from 0.7172 to 1.0, whereas stereocentre and formal-charge token rates are 0.0 throughout. These are string-presence counters, not aromatic atom fractions or measurements of basicity. The output spans moderately sized aryl carbonyl compounds, bulky halogenated amine assemblies, large decorated nitrogen heterocycles, and compact but highly interconnected sulfur cages. Within each task, late molecules mostly vary one established family; unique strings do not establish broad scaffold diversity. Conventional benzothiophene ketones, lactams, phenols and cyclic amines coexist with multiply bonded hydrogen-bearing sulfur, N-halogen bonds, reactive fluorides, peroxides and strained bridges. Overall synthetic plausibility and drug-like quality are poor despite abundant recognizable medicinal fragments. No stereoisomers are explicitly distinguished, including in the densely bridged products.

per_task.generated_character: Moderately sized fused-ring carbonyl compounds dominate. Earlier high-scoring members are benzothiophene aryl ketones with aniline, chloromethyl and aminomethoxy substituents. Later members retain an aryl or pyridyl ketone and methoxy group but introduce partially saturated fused rings, carbon-bound fluorine, N-fluoro or N-hydroxyfluoro groups, and unusual multiply bonded sulfur. Aromatic-token presence is 0.931 and halogen presence is 0.9621. The benzothiophene ketone is a comparatively recognizable synthetic scaffold, whereas the late sulfur and fluorinated-nitrogen connectivity is much less convincing. These are the same molecules as the paired parent output.
liabilities: N-F and N-O bonds, chloromethyl groups and unusual sulfur valence introduce potential chemical instability or reactivity.
The late family combines unspecified saturated-ring geometry with sulfur-containing unsaturation; parseable connectivity alone does not establish an accessible structure.
missing_features: Broader compact, conventionally bonded heteroaryl carbonyl families retaining the favorable ring arrangement are poorly represented among the late proposals.
Defined stereochemical alternatives are absent for the fluorinated saturated ring centres; the supplied scores do not establish whether stereochemistry is rewarded.
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The initial indole carboxamide scores 0.3051048083696145; a benzothiophene aryl ketone reaches 0.393567030299894, close to the best sulfur-containing pyridyl ketone at 0.3966634883331815. Consequently the unusual sulfur and N-F groups are not shown to be necessary for approaching this observed maximum. Ring expansion and partial loss of conjugation accompany the low optimizer example at 0.023463222457063. Expanding the pyridyl group into a larger sulfur-containing unsaturated ring gives 0.07287781628025475. The observed gradient favors a compact carbonyl-linked ring arrangement over these expanded alternatives; it does not identify a unique missing target group.

per_task.generated_character: These are large, heavily decorated arylamino nitrogen heterocycles. A fused nitrogen-rich carbonyl/thioxo core bears alkyl groups and a crowded substituted phenyl partner; later structures add imines, an alpha-fluoro amine linkage, a long ether/acetal/thioether chain, alkyl chloride, and a multiply bonded sulfur centre. The best member also carries N-Br. Every optimizer string contains aromatic and ring-closure tokens; mean SMILES length is 75.2, consistent with the visibly extensive substitution but not itself a molecular-size measurement. Early aryl esters and cyclic diones are more conventional than the late combinations of reactive groups. The paired parent has exactly this same chemistry.
liabilities: N-bromination, imines and the multiply bonded sulfur centre complicate chemical stability and synthetic plausibility.
Long flexible ether/acetal chains and dense alkyl/halogen substitution increase conformational and physicochemical liabilities.
Potential stereocentres in crowded fluorinated and alkoxy linkages are unspecified.
missing_features: Alternative accessible core geometries that preserve the recurring arylamino and carbonyl arrangement are not meaningfully represented in the late high-scoring family.
The high-scoring substitution pattern lacks a demonstrated compact version using stable linkers in place of its long heteroatom chain and reactive sulfur/nitrogen combinations.
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The initial fused dione scores 0.548381482770623, the low optimizer example with an opened fused core scores 0.5300762397705813, and the extensively decorated thioxo family reaches 0.6161710037174721. per_task.generated_character: Bulky halogenated diaryl molecules evolve from an acidic amide/sulfonamide family into compounds with phenol, fluorinated alkenes, aziridine and pyrrolidine amine centres, and an additional amino substituent.
